check.noMenu: Ragtop's settings aren't in the Omarchy menu.
check.switch: Can't read the tablet-mode switch. The installer can fix this.
choice.display.auto: Ragtop follows the touchscreen, or the built-in panel.
choice.keyboard.off: The keyboard is off. The bar icon is struck through while it is.
choice.keyboard.on: The keyboard is on offer whatever mode you are in.
choice.keyboard.sensor: The keyboard comes up in tablet mode.
choice.labels.large: The key labels are now large.
choice.labels.normal: The key labels are now normal.
choice.labels.small: The key labels are now small.
choice.layout.60: A 60% keyboard, where the screen is wide enough.
choice.layout.75: A 75% keyboard, where the screen is wide enough.
choice.layout.80: A tenkeyless keyboard, where the screen is wide enough.
choice.layout.auto: The keyboard picks the biggest board that fits.
choice.layout.mobile: The mobile keyboard, with its symbol pages.
choice.rotation.auto: The screen rotates while in tablet mode.
choice.tabletMode.auto: Tablet mode now follows the hardware: fold the screen back, or take the keyboard off.
choice.tabletMode.off: Tablet mode is off until you change it back.
choice.tabletMode.on: Tablet mode is on until you change it back.
clones.edited: Your copy of %1 has edits of its own, so it wasn't resynced.
clones.removed: Your copy of %1 couldn't be re-patched, so it was removed. Restart the shell to go back to Omarchy's own.
clones.updated: Overlay clones updated. Restart the shell to load them.
diagnostics.copied: Diagnostics copied. Paste them into your report.
install.done: Done. Ragtop's icons appear in the bar in tablet mode.
install.enabled: enabled in the bar's right section
install.exists: %1 already exists and isn't this checkout. Remove it first.
install.joinGroup: Alternatively, join its group and log in again (this also exposes your keyboards):
install.menu: Adding Ragtop's settings to the Omarchy menu (Setup › Tablet)
install.missingHow: Install them with Omarchy's own helper, which checks each one landed:
install.noSwitch: no device reports a tablet-mode switch. Ragtop will keep looking (a detachable's keyboard may add one), but tablet mode won't be detected until one appears. See 'Tablet-mode detection' in the README.
install.noTerminal: not running in a terminal, so not asking. Re-run install.sh in one, or pass --yes.
install.overlaysAsk: Turn all of them on now? [y/N]
install.overlaysCatch: The catch: a clone is Omarchy's own code, the password prompt and lock screen included, copied from its root-owned folder into your config, where anything running as you can rewrite it, and it stops taking Omarchy's updates directly (a hook re-clones it after each update). Leave this off if in doubt: you can turn each overlay on later in Setup › Tablet › System Overlays. See 'Omarchy's overlays' in the README.
install.overlaysChange: Change it per overlay in Setup › Tablet › System Overlays.
install.overlaysNoTerminal: left off, since this is not running in a terminal
install.overlaysSkipped: left off. Pass --overlays to turn them all on without asking
install.overlaysWhy: Omarchy's menu, its pickers, its password prompt and its lock screen can't be worked by touch as they ship. Ragtop can run patched clones of them instead: touch typing in each, a keyboard on the lock screen, and arrows and a Select button for the theme and background pickers.
install.restartForClones: the clones load when the shell restarts: omarchy-restart-shell
install.ruleAsk: Install it now? You'll be asked for your password. [y/N]
install.ruleInstalled: installed, and the switch is readable now
install.ruleOffer: Ragtop can install a udev rule giving the logged-in user read access to switch devices only (tablet mode, lid and headphone jack, never keyboards):
install.unreadable: %1 isn't readable by %2, so tablet mode can't be detected.
migrate.done: Ragtop brought your settings up to date for this version.
overlay.off.clipboard: Touch typing is off for the clipboard picker.
overlay.off.emojis: Touch typing is off for the emoji picker.
overlay.off.image-picker: The theme and background pickers no longer have arrows and a Select button.
overlay.off.lock: The lock screen no longer has an on-screen keyboard.
overlay.off.menu: Touch typing is off for the Omarchy menu.
overlay.off.polkit: Touch typing is off for the password prompt.
overlay.on.clipboard: Touch typing is on for the clipboard picker.
overlay.on.emojis: Touch typing is on for the emoji picker.
overlay.on.image-picker: The theme and background pickers now have arrows and a Select button in tablet mode.
overlay.on.lock: The lock screen now has an on-screen keyboard in tablet mode.
overlay.on.menu: Touch typing is on for the Omarchy menu.
overlay.on.polkit: Touch typing is on for the password prompt.
predictions.all: Word suggestions are on, in English on any layout.
predictions.layout: Word suggestions are on, in your layout's language.
predictions.off: Word suggestions are off, and swipe typing with them.
setup.noMenu: Ragtop's settings could not be added to Omarchy's menu. Run Setup again to retry.
setup.notCopied: These could not be copied: %1. Run Setup again to retry.
setup.notRemoved: These are still Ragtop's copies: %1. A copy with changes of your own is kept on purpose: undo those changes, or remove the copy yourself, and run Setup again.
setup.title: Ragtop setup
swipe.needsSuggestions: Turn on word suggestions first: swipe typing uses the same words.
switch.assists.off: Automatic capitals and double-space full stops are off.
switch.assists.on: Capitals at the start of sentences, and a full stop for a double space, are on.
switch.autoShow.off: The keyboard no longer comes up by itself on text fields.
switch.autoShow.on: The keyboard now comes up by itself on text fields.
switch.inputMethods.off: The keyboard no longer shows input method choices. fcitx5 shows its own.
switch.inputMethods.on: Chinese, Japanese and Korean input methods now show their choices on the keyboard.
switch.swipe.on: Swipe typing is on: draw a word across the letters.
uninstall.keptThemes: kept your own themes in %1 (delete it if you don't want them)
uninstall.leftPlugin: left %1 in place (remove it with: omarchy plugin remove %2)
uninstall.menu: Removing Ragtop's settings from the Omarchy menu
uninstall.rulePassword: removing the switch access rule needs your password
